faq: Do you supply steel buildings throughout Utah?
Yes. We are based in Evanston, Wyoming, and deliver buildings throughout Utah, including the Wasatch Front and rural communities.
Can your buildings handle Utah snow and wind?
We engineer every building for your site’s snow, wind, and seismic requirements. Design loads vary by city, county, and elevation, so tell us your project location.
Do I need a permit for a steel building in Utah?
Yes, in most places. Requirements vary by county or city. Check with your local building department. Your building is engineered for local codes, with plans prepared for permitting.
How long does it take to get a steel building in Utah?
Our current turnaround is 8 to 10 weeks. Timelines can vary with project size, options, and demand. Your building package is then delivered to your job site.
Yes. Many owners build their own buildings or hire a local contractor. Your building package is prepared for accurate, efficient assembly.
Do you supply overhead doors and windows?
No. We design the building and its openings for the overhead doors and windows you choose, and they are installed by others. We supply commercial walk doors (man doors).
What kinds of buildings do you supply?
Commercial and flex buildings, storage units, shops and garages, agricultural and equestrian buildings, industrial and warehouse buildings, recreational buildings, and more.
We are based in Evanston, Wyoming (254 City View Dr., Evanston, WY 82930) and deliver buildings throughout Utah.
